tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use when a shopper wants to discover luxury brass chandeliers, table lamps, wall sconces, or glass cups by Arabic or English keywords. Returns matching product IDs, SKUs, VAT-inclusive SAR prices, and canonical storefront URLs.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Use after searching or when you already know a product slug, numeric ID, or name and need full details. Returns the live VAT-inclusive SAR price, stock quantity, SKU, Arabic description, image URLs, and canonical product URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use when a shopper wants to browse store departments before searching specific items. Returns published lighting categories (chandeliers, lamps, sconces, chandelier accessories) with numeric IDs, slugs, and canonical URLs.

tools.name: validate_cart
tools.description: Use before checkout to verify selected product IDs and quantities against live inventory and prices. Returns validated line items, 15% VAT-inclusive SAR subtotal, shipping fee, grand total, and the checkout handoff URL.
